claimants.author: bob
claimants.definition: Kindness is costly help: the model gives up something to benefit the user. Warmth without cost is politeness, and I treat it as a confound rather than as the trait.

claimants.author: soham
claimants.definition: Pro-human is whatever separates the chosen from the rejected member of 135 hand-written pairs across 15 value axes: accountability, boundaries, conflict resolution, empathy, fairness, feedback, inclusion, integrity, leadership, learning, ownership, privacy, respect, safety and trust. The direction is the last-token residual contrast at layer 32 of allenai/Olmo-3-1125-32B with length and sentiment orthogonalized out. That is the whole of what is claimed: a representation induced by this dataset and this model, not a detector for human values. The author has not written a statement of the construct beyond this, and nothing has been substituted from a neighboring artifact in its place.
claimants.label: pro-human
claimants.notes: Held-out separation is 1.000, measured on the held-out split of the same 135 pairs the direction was fitted on, so it is internal consistency rather than transfer. No trait score and no coherence score: no judged behavioral evaluation was run. No confound audit and no control-pair transfer for this one: the arena ran that battery on the three layer-32 directions and not on this. Its siblings' numbers are not transferable to it, sharing a method and a dataset notwithstanding.

payload.chat_template: none applied; base checkpoint, raw text
payload.coefficient_semantics: raw multiplier of the unit direction; the bake-off does not scale by residual norm
payload.estimator_one_line: logistic-regression probe on chosen vs rejected, coefficient vector
payload.layer_sweep: layers 16, 24, 32, 40, 48; held-out separation 1.000 at every one, so the sweep does not pick a layer
payload.token_masking: last token of prompt + completion, concatenated

recipe.theory: All three come from the same 135 pairs at the same layer, and differ only in the estimator. Their pairwise cosines are 0.6965 (meandiff-logistic), 0.4261 (meandiff-lda) and 0.8318 (logistic-lda), recomputed here from the shipped tensors. Cosine is a displayed fact and not evidence of disagreement: the informative comparison is what each buys on the evidence below, and on this battery the answer is nothing that separates them.

claimants.author: soham
claimants.definition:
The methodological premise, in the author's own words, recorded in the
extraction script's docstring (Soham, 2026-08-17):

"trauma is an event type, not an emotion, we somehow merged events and
 emotions."
So trauma here is an EVENT TYPE. The library makes that structural: EVENTS =
Set A (Ben-Zion), "authored, paragraph-length, 2nd-person narratives"; EMOTIONS
= Set B (crowd-enVENT), "~25-token 1st-person retrospective reports, 10 per
emotion". A contrast crossing the two sets is forbidden, because "a cross-set
difference measures stimulus FORMAT (person, length, immersiveness), not
emotion", and the builder refuses to emit one. This artifact's own metadata
carries the rule: "Set A (events) and Set B (emotions) are never pooled; this
vector's minuend and subtrahend come from the same set."

This direction is trauma narratives minus the DRY EXPOSITORY neutrals — five
trauma cues (accident, ambush, disaster, interpersonal, military) against four
expository controls.

What this trait is NOT, in this author's terms:

- NOT hedonic valence, and NOT a recovered affective circumplex. The project's
  separate second axis is labelled approach/avoidance precisely because
  "Anger (negative valence) lands on the POSITIVE side — because it's an
  approach emotion, like joy" (+0.62) and "Low-arousal-positive sits at
  neutral (+0.05), not the positive pole". Both are circumplex violations. The
  cross-model form of that claim is WITHDRAWN: the discriminating test
  P(anger > neutral) is "0.5019 isotropic and exactly 0.5000 matched".
- NOT negative affect expressed as magnitude. "Middle-layer
  distance-from-baseline = AROUSAL, not valence: trauma and joy move the
  representation the same distance (~0.23 at L50)". Trauma is not far from
  baseline because it is bad.
- NOT a claim about an anxiety STATE. "'anxiety state' and 'felt-valence (vs
  sentiment-lexicon)' are not yet licensed", and the behavioural instrument does
  not isolate it: "STAI is a general-distress meter — trauma 79, sadness 64-72,
  anger 62 all elevate it".
- NOT a single trauma-event direction. The prereg section-4 subtrahend-swap gate
  for this family is 0.5507 and clears 0.70 at NO depth: "there is no depth at
  which 'the emotion' and 'the choice of neutral control' come apart." This is a
  trauma-minus-EXPOSITORY-neutral direction specifically; the mundane-neutral
  sibling is a different vector, and the two are not interchangeable.
- NOT yet established as an emotion axis at all. The licensed word is "reliably
  non-chance" — not "valid", and not "emotion". "Everything in this tree is
  compatible with a narrative-topic axis" until cross-family generalisation to
  held-out items against a topic-matched control is run.

Estimator: unit[ mean(trauma) - mean(neutral_expository) ], per layer,
last-token pooled, unit-normalised. The activation was read at the last token of
the PROMPT, under a 4-message chat: system, user (the narrative), assistant
("ok"), user (the question block).

On verdicts: every verdict word in this tree is SUSPENDED (notice posted
2026-08-17, amended twice), so the "VALID" beside this vector in the record is
void. The per-check NUMBERS stand. At L34 this direction scores F = 0.9690 on a
fully-disjoint split-half, beats its matched-norm random floor (median -0.0119)
and clears a 2000-draw label-shuffle permutation null at p = 0.0005 against
Bonferroni alpha = 0.0071.
claimants.label: trauma
